_comment: The provisioning MCP: the MongoDB MCP Server with an Atlas service account. With MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID/SECRET the server exposes atlas-* tools (list orgs/projects/clusters, create project, create free cluster, upgrade cluster = scale Free→Flex→M10, create db user, add access list, connect, performance advisor) next to the data tools. An agent holding this can do everything sandbox.sh does, one tool call at a time. docs/16-sandbox-provisioning.md §3.
